create_Lambda_bijector_from_forward_fn: create a Lambda bijector by passing a forward callable like lambda x: jnp.tanh(x)
create_Lambda_bijector_from_inverse_fn: create a Lambda bijector by passing an inverse callable and let forward be auto-derived
create_Lambda_bijector_with_log_det_jaco: create a Lambda bijector with explicit forward and inverse log det jacobian callables
run_Lambda_forward_and_log_det: run forward_and_log_det on a Lambda bijector to get transformed output and log determinant together
review_Lambda_same_as_comparison: review the same_as method to compare two Lambda bijectors for functional equivalence
